sprint_goal: Migrate core Hive tables to Delta Lake with ACID transactions and schema compatibility, laying foundation for unified lakehouse architecture.

tasks.title: Assess existing Hive table schemas and dependencies
tasks.description: Analyze 500+ Hive tables to document schema details, dependencies, and BI connections for compatibility validation prior to Delta conversion.

tasks.title: Convert high-priority Hive tables to Delta format
tasks.description: Use Databricks utilities to convert top 50 Hive tables to Delta format ensuring backward-compatible schema and support for existing SQL queries.

tasks.title: Validate dashboard connectivity post migration
tasks.description: Test Tableau and Looker dashboards against newly migrated Delta tables to confirm zero downtime and data consistency.

tasks.title: Implement ACID transactions on Delta tables
tasks.description: Configure Delta transaction logs and validate concurrent write scenarios across ETL jobs to ensure consistent records and integrity.

tasks.title: Enable time travel with 30-day retention policy
tasks.description: Activate Delta Lake time travel settings and configure retention period for historical version snapshots, verifying rollback and audit queries.

tasks.title: Implement Z-ordering and auto compaction for performance
tasks.description: Apply Z-order indexing on top 20 query columns and enable Delta automatic compaction policies to improve query performance and storage efficiency.

tasks.title: Register migrated tables in Unity Catalog
tasks.description: Integrate Delta tables into Unity Catalog to enforce centralized access controls, lineage tracking, and permission audits.

risks.description: Dashboard downtime during table migration may impact business reporting.
risks.mitigation: Implement shadow tables and switch dashboards post verification without interrupting refresh cycles.

risks.description: ETL jobs might fail due to schema mismatches after conversion.
risks.mitigation: Perform pre-migration schema validation and regression testing before full rollout.

risks.description: Query performance gains may not meet 50% target due to suboptimal Z-order columns.
risks.mitigation: Conduct profiling to identify columns with highest filter frequency and fine-tune Z-order strategy.

risks.description: Access policies may break if Unity Catalog integration is misconfigured.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with test users and validate permissions before global rollout.

definition_of_done: All high-priority Hive tables converted to Delta format successfully
No dashboard downtime or errors during migration
ACID transactions validated for concurrent ETL workloads
Time travel retention confirmed at 30 days
Query performance improvement of at least 50% verified
Unity Catalog registration completed for migrated tables
All tasks reviewed and tested in staging environment
